name: Horde Breakers
subtitle: Extract or Hold the Line
promotionalText: Every 10 waves: extract and bank up to ×2 your score, or hold the line for more. Every map fights back. Squad up with up to 3 friends in online co-op.
description:
Every 10 waves the chopper comes. Extract now and bank your score with a multiplier — or hold the line for a bigger one and risk losing it all.

Horde Breakers is a zombie survival shooter where the map fights back and you decide when to get out.

EXTRACT OR HOLD THE LINE
At waves 10, 20 and 30 the fight stops and you choose: take the extraction and bank your score at ×1.25, ×1.5, ×1.75 and up to ×2, plus a scrap crate, or stay for the next multiplier. Die before you extract and the bonus is gone. Banked runs rank on their own Extraction leaderboard.

THE MAP FIGHTS BACK
Every map has its own event that changes the fight mid-wave:
• Overpass: a pile-up collapses onto the road, blocks your lane and the horde reroutes around the wreck.
• Dead Mall: the fountain floods the floor and crawlers slow to a crawl in the water.
• Military Base: searchlights sweep the yard and stalkers can no longer hide.
• Street: the streetlights fail and the block goes dark.

BOSSES THAT ADAPT
Four bosses guard every fifth wave. Survive past wave 25 and each one returns as a variant: the Goliath wears a helmet you have to shoot off before headshots count, and the Abomination bursts into bloaters when it dies.

STACK THE ODDS AGAINST YOURSELF
Switch on mutators like Glass Cannon, No Radar, Iron Sights, Double Runners and No Pickups to multiply your score up to ×2.5.

RACE THE WORLD #1, WAVE BY WAVE
Every Daily Challenge is fully seeded: the same spawns, perks and drops for every player. A pace line in your HUD compares you with your best run and with the world #1 after every wave. On the leaderboard, every player shows up in the outfit they ran with.

SQUAD UP
4-player online co-op through Game Center. Revive downed teammates, play the Squad Daily together and climb Ranked Weekly from Bronze to Legend.

BUILD YOUR RUN
Pick an upgrade after every wave, with a legendary offer every 10th. Earn rifles, shotguns, a sniper rifle, a grenade launcher and a flamethrower with in-game scrap. Four premium weapons are available as in-app purchases: a black hole launcher that drags the horde together, a freeze beam that shatters frozen infected, chain lightning and an incendiary minigun.

Seasons bring a cosmetic-only Season Pass, so nobody can pay to win. 25 Game Center achievements to hunt.

No ads. No tracking. No data collected.
